summary: Install-time dependency resolved from non-registry host with install scripts enabled
details: package.json and npm-shrinkwrap.json declare a dependency `linker-event-header-serial` resolved directly from `https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/linker-event-header-serial` rather than the npm registry. The shrinkwrap entry sets `hasInstallScript: true`, so `npm install commonweb-flow` fetches an arbitrary tarball from `artifacts.yosiroute.com` and executes its lifecycle scripts on the installer's host. The `yosiroute.com` host is not affiliated with the npm registry, is not the publisher's documented domain, and the tarball at that URL is mutable — the bytes executed on install are whatever the third-party host serves at fetch time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
